description: Laufen, in Basel-Landschaft, is the small town on the Birs whose cobbled main street runs between the town gates, with the baroque church of St. Katharina at the lower end and the town hall above. It has belonged to Basel-Landschaft since 1994. This is not Schloss Laufen above the Rhine Falls, which stands in the canton of Zurich. The Open-Meteo model is fully overcast, with no rain.
